purpose: Qualify direct Chromium delivery of canonical native download URLs and distinguish descriptor release from public access
baseline: 2b3c85c release 0.14.0 plus retained PNG and overlapping-reference work
requiredFacts: Use retained canonical native request URLs, without another provider route builder
Fetch with omitted credentials, redirect refusal, no-store and a finite deadline from the exact publication origin
Observe CORS responses, PNG MIME, declared length, byte digest, dimensions and pixels
An opaque origin cannot read the same response under the substitute's selected-origin CORS policy
Public bytes can remain accessible after final logical release even when authenticated descriptors refuse
Original upload claims, PUT counts and physical/liability accounting remain unchanged
retention: Retain every attempt/log, original profiles/journals/native requests, source snapshots, exact harness/bundles/CLI/Wasm and browser observations under .tmp/public-delivery-01
limitations: Owned substitute MIME/CORS behavior does not establish deployed Caffeine serving behavior
No public serving lease, confidentiality, cache policy, CSP, retention, deletion or billing-cessation guarantee
No new product API, provider contract, retry owner, live deployment, paid effect or sibling edit
